caption: Switch a window to a space that another window shows, and both windows show the same workspaces and the same live terminal.

steps.title: A terminal with some output
cmux:
command=clear; printf '
  \033[1;34mBUILD\033[0m

  \033[32m+\033[0m compile
  \033[32m+\033[0m link
  \033[32m+\033[0m done
'; sleep 900

steps.title: New Window: a second window, on a new space
Next Space: this window shows the second window's workspace
Previous Space: back to the first space
